raw_segments.text: Benedict, Troth, my lord, I have played the part of Lady Fame.
I found him here as melancholy as a lodge and a warren.
I told him, and I think I told him true, that your grace had got the good will of this young
And I offered him my company to a willow tree, either to make him a garland, as being forsaken,
or to bind him up a rod, as being worthy to be whipped."
